name: Tiles & Pottery of the World
subtitle: Delftware, Iznik & more
shortDescription: 7 tile painting and pottery traditions to play: Delftware tile painting, Jaipur blue pottery, Marginea black pottery and Bolesławiec pottery.
longDescription:
Tiles & Pottery of the World: 7 tile painting and pottery traditions from 7 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Delftware tile painting, Jaipur blue pottery, Marginea black pottery, Bolesławiec pottery, Deruta ceramics, Iznik tile painting and Talavera tile painting.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can paint tiles and decorate pottery in traditional styles, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
